bills.title: Revise the Ohio Uniform Commercial Code
Ratify the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
bills.detail: To amend sections 3313.537, 4731.156, and 5903.12; to enact sections 3301.0717, 3301.0733, 3313.5321, 3313.6025, 4731.191, and 4732.42; and to repeal section 4731.155 of the Revised Code to ratify the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists, to modify the Interstate Massage Compact (IMpact), to require, instead of permit, continuing education for massage therapists, regarding the success sequence curriculum, to require the Department of Education and Workforce to submit a report regarding a single, statewide hybrid assessment system, and to enact the Student Athlete Mobility (SAM) Act regarding student petitions to participate in extracurricular activities at neighboring public schools.

label: Week 41, 2026
recap:
This week was quiet, with six bill movements and two case updates across three jurisdictions. Ohio accounted for three, the District of Columbia two, and Pennsylvania one. The activity centered on criminal law and transparency and disclosure, two movements each, covering new offenses and evidence rules for AI conduct and labeling and disclosure requirements.

Children and minors, health care, and workforce and education each appeared once, alongside two unthemed bills. No federal documents were recorded. A bill movement means a bill's record changed status, not that it passed.

courts.title: University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC
courts.detail: University of Tennessee Research Foundation sued Anthropic PBC in the District Court, D. Delaware, on July 20, 2026. The docket entries indicate a patent infringement claim with a jury demand, and the report to the Commissioner of Patents and Trademarks lists patent numbers US 10,019,470 B2 and US 10,095,718 B2. Anthropic PBC was served on July 21, 2026, and its answer is due August 11, 2026. As of the newest entry on July 30, 2026, pro hac vice attorneys Dorian S. Berger, Daniel P. Hipskind, and Erin E. McCracken have been added for University of Tennessee Research Foundation, and no answer from Anthropic PBC appears in the record.
